items.title: Shenron, Auras, Over 9,000 and More
items.why:
These are the pictures you asked for in the audit, each redrawn with care so it doesn't look cheap: the seven Dragon Balls, the Senzu beans on the streak card, the Super Saiyan aura forms, the over-9,000 moment, Shenron for the wish card, and the Turtle School theme on real screens.

The fan-made notice is plain text, so it goes in as written: "Goku is a fan-made app. Dragon Ball belongs to Akira Toriyama, Bird Studio, Shueisha and Toei Animation. Goku is not affiliated with them."

items.title: Glass Dragon Balls
items.why: The seven milestone balls as amber glass with red stars floating inside, a window shine and a warm glow at the bottom. Balls not yet gathered are frosted grey with grey stars.

items.title: Senzu Beans on the Streak Card
items.why: Each saved Senzu bean drawn as a shiny green bean, matching the new Supplements icon.

items.title: Super Saiyan Aura Forms
items.why: Your avatar's aura grows with your streak, with the form's name shown when you hold the avatar. Gold flames for Super Saiyan; lightning added at Super Saiyan 2; taller flames at 3; red for God at 30 days; blue at 60; silver Ultra Instinct at 100. The flames move gently unless Reduce Motion is on. The 悟 emblem stands in for anyone's avatar here.

items.title: "It's Over 9,000!"
items.why: The one-time moment when your power level first passes 9,000: a scouter readout, the line, and one button. It shows once per profile.

items.title: Shenron Rising from the Dragon Balls
items.why: For the wish card when all seven are gathered: Shenron's long green body with a pale belly and back fins, antler horns, red eyes, whiskers and little clawed arms, rising out of the seven balls.

options.label: Closer, but try again
options.desc: Say what's off in the note.

items.title: Turtle School Theme
items.why: Goku's gi as a theme: orange buttons and highlights, cream pages in light mode, deep navy in dark. Shown on Home, light on a phone and dark on a desktop. Text contrast would be checked by the theme test before release.
